This is a translation layout demonstration. No source text, translated work, author, or translator has been supplied, so no translation or attribution is presented here.

## A note before the text

A published translation can begin with a short introduction explaining what the source is and why it is being translated. The optional credit fields hold the original author, source title, source URL, source language, and translator.

## Translator’s notes

Notes can explain a particular term, a reference in the original, or a decision about tone. They need not interrupt every paragraph. A numbered list is available when notes correspond to specific passages.

1. Identify the passage being discussed.
2. Explain the choice in clear language.
